title: Language from a Boolean function
statement: Given a function $f$ from Boolean lists to Boolean lists and a Boolean mode, define a language of Boolean lists by indexing each input $z$ at position $p$: in true mode, accept exactly when $p$ is less than the length of the query associated to $f$ and $z$; in false mode, accept exactly when the bit at position $p$ in that query, using false when the position is out of range, is true.
hypotheses_covered: Function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists
caveat: The snippet does not define the query function or the language-indexing construction, so their precise input encoding and semantics are unavailable.
